why_head_pre: Most AI writing tools want to be ChatGPT.
why_head_accent: NovelWeaver wants to write a book.
why_lead: Generic chatbots can spit out a paragraph. They can't hold a 24-chapter narrative together while keeping ten characters distinct, your magic system internally consistent, and your tone steady. That's a different problem.
why_body: We built NovelWeaver as a story engine — long-context, character-aware, plot-tracking. The AI does the holding-it-together. You do the inventing.
stats: Words possible per novel on Pro. We've stress-tested books at 150,000.
Average chapter generation time on Pro. Faster than re-reading what you wrote yesterday.
Every word. We don't claim ownership of generated text. Sell, publish, or just keep it for yourself.
faq: Less than you'd expect. Pro models, careful prompting, and your edits make for human-readable prose. Pure AI never beats AI + author. NovelWeaver is the second option.
Can I publish what I write?
Yes. You own the output. Use it for personal projects, KDP self-publishing, blogs, fiction collections — whatever you like.
Do you train on my writing?
No. Your manuscripts and edits are not used to train AI models. They stay yours, encrypted, on our servers (or fully on-device with the upcoming local mode).
How long does a chapter take?
30–90 seconds depending on length and model. Pro users get priority queue access, especially during peak hours.
Can I write in a language other than English?
Yes — French, German, Spanish, Italian, Portuguese, Dutch, Swedish, Polish, Japanese and more, with native fluency.
NovelWeaver output is AI-assisted, not copy-pasted from existing works. Detection tools may flag any AI-touched text — that's worth knowing if you're submitting to publishers who forbid AI use.
Through your phone's subscription settings — Apple ID or Google Play. We don't pull dark patterns to keep you.
final_body: Free to download. iPhone and Android. The first chapter writes itself. The rest is on you.
